City Council and Community Development Commission Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente City Council and Community Development Commission Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
FEBRUARY 8, 2011
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS: House, Mendoza, Solis, Holloway, Argudo
COMMISSIONERS: House, Mendoza, Solis, Holloway, Argudo
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS - None.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL/COMMISSION MEETINGS - None.
RECESS THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1290 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2010-11
Action Taken: The City Council adopted the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1290.
CC.D-1 Warrant Register
D-2
ACCEPTANCE OF EASEMENT DEEDS FOR SIDEWALK IMPROVEMENTS AT SUNSET AVENUE SOUTH OF TEMPLE AVENUE
Action Taken: The City Council:
1) Adopt the attached Resolution accepting the easement deeds; and
2) Direct the City Clerk to record the easement deeds in the County Recorder’s Office.
CC.D-2 Sidewalk Easement Report
CC.D-2 Sidewalk Easement Attachment A
CC.D-2 Sidewalk Easement - Attachment B
D-3
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE RECONSTRUCTION OF INYO STREET AND ARDILLA STREET AND SEWER IMPROVEMENT IN INYO STREET
Action Taken: The City Council:
1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Reconstruction of Inyo Street and Ardilla Street Improvement Project and Inyo Street Sewer Improvements; and
2) Authorize staff to solicit bids.
CC.D-3 Auth to Solicit Bids-Inyo Ardilla Report
CC.D-3 ATTACHMENT A
D-4
SECOND READING - ADOPTION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT ("MCA-135") ADOPTION OF ZONING REGULATIONS PERTAINING TO LARGE FAMILY DAYCARE HOMES WITHIN THE RESIDENTIAL ZONES OF THE CITY. (Introduced and title read at meeting of January 25, 2011)
Action Taken: The City Council adopted Ordinance No. 11-910 adding Sections 10.08.900, 10.08.910 and 10.16.010(n) to Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code Pertaining to Zoning Regulations of Large Family Daycare Homes in the Residential Zones of the City (Municipal Code Amendment No. 135)
CC.D-4 Large Family Daycare Ordinance 2nd Reading _Adoption_
CC.D-4 MCA 135 - Attachment A
CC.D-4 MCA 135 - Attachment B
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH RAUL ROMERO FOR INTERIM CITY MANAGER SERVICES
Action Taken: The City Council approved the agreement with Raul Romero for Interim City Manager services and authorized the Mayor to execute the agreement, subject to review and approval by the Interim City Attorney as to form.
CC.D-5 Interim City Manager agreement
CC.D-5 Interim City Manager agreement-attachment A
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM URGENCY ORDINANCE FOR CONTRACT AMENDMENT-TWO YEARS ADDITIONAL SERVICE CREDIT
CC.E-1 Calpers Amendment to Contract Urgency Ordinance staff report
CC.E-1 Urgency Ordinance Amendment to PERS Contract Attach A
CC.E-1 Calpers Amendment to Contract-exhibit A
CC.E-1 CalPERS Certification of Final Action of Governing Body-attachment B
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE AMENDING THE APPOINTMENT PROCESS FOR PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council:
CC.E-2 PC Appointment Report
CC.E-2 PC Appointment Ordinance Attach A
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF RESCINDING ALL PLANNING COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS MADE ON JANUARY 25, 2011 (Council Member House)
Council Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss, rescind and provide staff with direction to proceed.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT(S) TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION
It is recommended that the City Council make the appointment(s) to fill vacancy(ies) on the Planning Commission.
CC.E-4 Planning Commission Appointment_s_ Report
CC.E-4 Planning Commission Applications Att A
E-5
UPDATE CITY ORDINANCES, RESOLUTIONS, POLICIES AND PROCEDURES (Council Member Solis)
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER CDC 141 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2010-11
Action Taken: The Commission adopted Resolution No. 11- approving Warrant Register No. CDC 141.
CDC.D-1 Warrant Register
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION - None.
RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9 (a) TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--EXISTING LITIGATION: Today's Holistic Collective v. City of La Puente, Case Number: KC060043.
F-2
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9 (a) TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--EXISTING LITIGATION: Today's Holistic Collective., Tom Noice v. City of La Puente, Case Number: KC060451.
F-3
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(b), SIGNIFICANT EXPOSURE TO LITIGATION, TO CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION: TWO (2) CASES
F-4
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957.6, CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS:
CITY OF LA PUENTE: RAUL ROMERO, INTERIM CITY MANAGER
EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATION: LA PUENTE PROFESSIONALS, SUPERVISORS, MANAGERS AND CONFIDENTIAL EMPLOYEE ASSOCIATION
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION
AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS - None.
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS - None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL/COMMISSION - None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.

Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Commission regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection at the City Clerk Department at City Hall located at 15900 E Main Street and the Reference Desk at the Library located at 15920 E. Central during normal business hours. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council/Commission shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council/Commission. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
